mapper.sql: id, host_member_id, NULL AS host_nickname, title, description, meeting_place, scheduled_at, capacity, target_distance_km, target_pace_seconds_per_km, status, cancelled_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO running_sessions ( host_member_id, title, description, meeting_place, scheduled_at, capacity, target_distance_km, target_pace_seconds_per_km, status ) VALUES ( #{hostMemberId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{meetingPlace}, #{scheduledAt}, #{capacity}, #{targetDistanceKm}, #{targetPaceSecondsPerKm}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT rs.id, rs.host_member_id, host.nickname AS host_nickname, rs.title, rs.description, rs.meeting_place, rs.scheduled_at, rs.capacity, rs.target_distance_km, rs.target_pace_seconds_per_km, rs.status, rs.cancelled_at, rs.created_at, rs.updated_at, COALESCE(pc.participant_count, 0) AS participant_count, CASE WHEN mp.member_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS current_member_participating, CASE WHEN rs.host_member_id = #{memberId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS current_member_hosting FROM running_sessions rs INNER JOIN members host ON host.id = rs.host_member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS participant_count FROM running_session_participants GROUP BY session_id ) pc ON pc.session_id = rs.id LEFT JOIN running_session_participants mp ON mp.session_id = rs.id AND mp.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OPEN' AND rs.scheduled_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND COALESCE(pc.participant_count, 0) < rs.capacity THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, rs.scheduled_at DESC, rs.id DESC

SELECT rs.id, rs.host_member_id, host.nickname AS host_nickname, rs.title, rs.description, rs.meeting_place, rs.scheduled_at, rs.capacity, rs.target_distance_km, rs.target_pace_seconds_per_km, rs.status, rs.cancelled_at, rs.created_at, rs.updated_at FROM running_sessions rs INNER JOIN members host ON host.id = rs.host_member_id WHERE rs.id = #{sessionId}

SELECT
FROM running_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE running_sessions SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, meeting_place = #{meetingPlace}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, capacity = #{capacity}, target_distance_km = #{targetDistanceKm}, target_pace_seconds_per_km = #{targetPaceSecondsPerKm} WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'CANCELLED'
UPDATE running_sessions SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND status != 'CANCELLED'
